subject: biology
title: Nature or Nurture
welcome_lead: Decide whether each feature comes from your genes, your environment, or a mix of both.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on inherited vs environmental variation.
final_note: You can now sort features into inherited, environmental and both.

concepts.def: Passed on from parents through genes.
Some features depend on genes and environment.
Section of DNA controlling a feature.
What you eat — affects many features.

walkthroughs.body_html: Some features come only from your genes, like eye colour or blood group. Even if your environment changes, these stay the same.
Other features are caused by your environment. A scar from a cut, a suntan, or how you speak depend on lifestyle and surroundings, not genes.
Many features come from both, like height and weight. Genes set a range; diet and exercise decide where in that range you land.
